prompt_en: Photorealistic documentary photograph of an original adult fictional woman working as a clinical nurse in an earthquake-aftershock backup ward as power transfers from emergency batteries to a generator. She is an adult clinical nurse in coherent scrub workwear: short-sleeved top, trousers, clinical shoes, ID badge, and gloves. Her long dark softly waved hair is secured; use Image 1 as the reference used only for visible facial and hair appearance guidance. Show one gloved hand stabilizing an IV line while the other checks a portable vital-sign monitor for an adult patient on a cot. She checks the patient identifier before assessment, performs a bedside vital-sign assessment, and confirms the charted reading matches the bedside monitor, so the patient-linked task carries the professional role. Matching blue symbols link wristband and chart; a green check echoes the monitor. Amber battery lamps coexist with cool ceiling lights returning in a staggered row; curtains swing and plaster dust falls. Capture a tense but controlled disaster-care atmosphere. Eye-level three-quarter framing keeps her face, uniform, hands, patient marker, monitor, and chart visible with plausible anatomy and contact.
